description: Read available operation events for at most ten seconds, stopping earlier at max_events or a terminal event. This is a bounded snapshot, not a wait for deployment completion. Use operation_get for current progress and keep the same operation. Stream failures are errors, not empty logs.

profile_name.description: Saved login to act as (profile_list shows them). Needed only when several logins could run this call; OHMYHOST_PROFILE of this server must match it.

name: operation_logs
